This is what I use in my work

-   I do all my academic writing in LaTeX (via Overleaf) with references stored in Zotero
-   I read and annotate all my PDFs with Goodnotes and Zotero, both on desktop and on iPadOS.
-   I post almost everything I write or develop on [GitHub](https://github.com/andrewheiss).
-   I use [R](https://www.r-project.org/) and either [Positron](https://positron.posit.co/) or [RStudio](https://www.rstudio.com/) for my statistical computing, and I'm a dedicated devotee of the [tidyverse](http://tidyverse.org/).
-   My website uses [Quarto](https://quarto.org/docs/websites/). <!-- -   I'm partial to both [Fira Code](https://github.com/tonsky/FiraCode) and [Consolas](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Consolas) for my monospaced fonts. -->
-   I use [Dropbox](https://www.dropbox.com) for syncing stuff across my different devices.
-   I use a 2026 14″ M5 Pro MacBook Pro, a 13″ iPad Pro, and an iPhone 16.
